question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute for the underlined word.**

The weather forecast mentioned that there would be a **__cloud burst__** this afternoon.
solution:
The correct answer is "rainstorm."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

 

__
 
• The term **"cloud burst"** refers to a sudden and intense release of rain from a cloud. (बादल से अचानक और तीव्र बारिश का निकलना)** **

 
 
• **Example**: *The **cloud burst**__ unleashed a torrent of rain, and flooding the streets.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most suitable synonym for "cloud burst" in the given context is "rainstorm."
 
• A **rainstorm** involves heavy or prolonged rainfall, and it accurately captures the idea of a sudden release of a significant amount of rain as implied by the term** "cloud burst"** in the original sentence. (भारी या लंबे समय तक वर्षा)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The sudden **rainstorm**__ caught us by surprise during our picnic.*​
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Sandstorm: **a storm in a desert in which sand is blown into the air by strong winds. (रेतीली आँधी, रेतीला तूफ़ान)
 
• **Famine: **a lack of food over a long period of time in a large area that can cause the death of many people. (किसी क्षेत्र में लंबे समय तक भोजन की कमी से होनेवाली मौतें; दुर्भिक्ष, अकाल)
 
• **Snowfall: **the snow that falls on one occasion. (हिमपात, बर्फ़बारी)
